verdict.rationale: Ardent documents its own public REST API for CI, internal platforms, dashboards and agent workflows. It exposes even fine-grained operational controls such as connector deletion locks and quarantine release, plus role-scoped automation tokens and a scriptable CLI with JSON output. No evidence states the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a published OpenAPI spec or full endpoint reference, documented API coverage of branch and project operations, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the API when you are building CI systems, internal developer platforms, custom dashboards, or agent workflows.
